blade.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite animation sheet for a small cave skeleton-dragon enemy in a 2D side-scrolling pixel-art game. Reference image is the existing player: preserve its recognizable round long-snouted head, very plump pear-shaped torso, short chunky forearms, short hind legs, tiny rear tail, upright biped posture, right-facing side view, no back fins, no horns, no wings, no extra limbs. Turn ONLY its body into an ivory fossil skeleton: round skull with a large dark eye socket, the same short rounded snout, broad curved ribcage following the potbelly, short spine and tail vertebrae, short arm and leg bones with readable joint ends. This must look like the skeleton of that plump character, NOT a thin humanoid, not an aggressive four-legged dragon. Weapon: one short slightly curved single-edged iron dao sword with dark brown grip, consistently held in the same forward hand. Same individual skeleton and weapon size/colors in EVERY frame, whole-body articulation, arms remain thick bones not lines.
Create an exact regular 6-column by 5-row atlas, thirty distinct full-body frames, each cell equal and with transparent gaps, no text or grid. Within every cell, logical canvas96x96, foot baseline at y80, body visible height42 logical pixels, skeleton centered around x42, weapon may extend to x90 or upward y15. Do not make the body larger on attack frames. Cell bounds must not crop weapon or hands.
Row1 six idle breathing/weight-shift frames, closed loop, dao held at waist. Row2 six real walking frames, contact/down/pass/up/contact/down, alternating bent knees, moving pelvis and tail, dao follows wrist, side view. Row3 six downward slash frames in temporal order: grounded rest, bend knees draw blade above head, blade fully raised, decisive vertical down-cut with torso leaning forward and hands following, blade finishes low beside hip, settle back to stance. Row4 six upward slash frames: low sword ready, sink/coil, blade travels upward through front, fully rising cut ending near shoulder, arm withdraws, return. Row5 six thrust frames: pull sword back by hip and bend legs, aim forward, extend arms and shift weight for a clear straight rightward stab, full extension, withdraw, guard recovery. No magic sword trails or text symbols baked into body frames.
True hand-placed-looking low resolution hard pixel clusters; ivory cream bones with muted brown joint shadows, charcoal cracks, small slate-gray blade highlights; only32 colors. Logical sprite atlas576x480 enlarged exactly 3x nearest-neighbor (1728x1440) as source. Crisp square pixels, no antialiasing, no painted texture, no soft shadows. Frame positions and body scale consistent, view fully right, transparent background is real alpha. No floor, no grass, no scenery, no colored glow, no watermark.
